changes.text: Added professional global footer with dynamic licensing information.
Implemented context-aware global Back button for seamless deep-app navigation.
Replaced all legacy emojis with enterprise-grade scalable vector icons (Lucide).

Desktop application wrapper implemented for native local execution.
Automated PDF and image OCR integration for smart data extraction.
Comprehensive history tracking for approved and rejected trips.
